Crown Jewel and Sail Portland Maine are teaming up together to bring you one of the most unique happy hour/brunch experiences in Portland. Hop aboard the classic Downeast picnic boat Calista Ann for a slow cruise out to Cruise to Crown Jewel for Flappy Hour on the island or an incredible brunch!

services.name: Classic Motoryacht Chartered Cruise
services.desc: Escape the crowds and embrace adventure with a cruise aboard our classic motor yacht, the Calista Ann! Whether you're a seasoned sailor or a first-timer, our Coast Guard certified professional captains will ensure an unforgettable experience on the water. During your journey, you'll encounter: The stunning vistas of the Maine Coastline Exploration of historic forts and picturesque lighthouses The chance to spot local wildlife such as seals and porpoises Engaging insights into the area's rich history and the bay's significance A dedicated and knowledgeable crew, eager to ensure your Offering custom private charters, public cruises, and sunset cruises for up to 12 guests.
